title: Require Domain Subdomain Source Topology
forbids: semantic subdomain roots outside their positive contract, router, operation, atom, and policy spine
why: A semantic subdomain is one non-empty operation contract and router boundary. Shared domain atoms remain reserved root capabilities rather than being misclassified as executable branches.
remediate: Keep index.ts, contract.ts, router.ts, and ops; retain atoms or policy only when the branch owns those capabilities; move every other child to its actual kind owner.
message: Domain subdomains should match the positive subdomain blueprint spine.
